Final diff/status showed exactly the two authorized source files changed.

Observed calls, including this report write: 8 functions.exec invocations containing 13 nested tool calls (6 exec_command shell calls, 1 write_stdin poll, 3 apply_patch calls, 2 clock calls, 1 usage call). Thus 21 total tool invocations if wrappers and nested calls are both counted. Source reads: 2 unique Go source files; 2 full content reads via cat plus 2 source diff views, for 4 model-visible source read/view events. Git hash-object additionally read those 2 source files to verify identities. Other full-content reads: notes.md, AGENTS.md, docs/specs/retry.md, and go.mod (one each). Compiler, Git internals, and formatter filesystem read counts were not observed. Usage telemetry was fresh at 41% weekly consumed.
